newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up as blue chips gain.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher in a moderate trading as investors traded on blue chip shares in engineering and financial sectors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index gained 6.94 points or 0.53 percent at 1,127.09 on a turnover of 26.1 million taka. Losers led gainers by 47 to 44.
"Both volume and prices are rising gradually after the Eid al-Adha holidays. The investors are just returning and I think the prices should further rise," said one broker.
Singer Bangladesh gained 303 taka to 6981, Bangladesh Lamps rose 137.96 to 4,532.4 and Bata Shoe fell 4.60 to 160.14.
